name: Microsoft 365 Personal for students
summary: Half-price Microsoft 365 Personal: the full desktop apps, Copilot and 1 TB of OneDrive.
who: Full-time and part-time students at accredited universities and colleges.
numbers: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Outlook, with Copilot
how: Sign in with a Microsoft account and verify your student status.
catches: You need to re-verify every year. If you no longer qualify, the price rises to the full monthly price.
Check whether your uni already gives you Office for free before you pay.
